title: PJ Masks. Catboy and the night.
lines: During the day Connor, Amaya and Greg are ordinary children.
They go to school, they play in the playground and they eat their sandwiches.
But at night, when everyone is asleep, they become heroes!
Then they put on their pyjamas.
They press the button on their bracelets.
And whoosh, they change!
Connor becomes Catboy, in a blue suit with cat ears.
He can run very fast and jump very high.
And he has super good ears.
Amaya becomes Owlette, in a red suit with wings.
She can fly and she has owl eyes, which let her see very far.
Greg becomes Gekko, in a green suit.
He can climb up walls and he is super strong.
Catboy is fast like a cat.
Owlette sees like an owl.
And Gekko climbs like a lizard.
Together they are the PJ Masks!
One day, at school, something strange is going on.
The teacher is looking for her keys.
The caretaker is looking for his hammer.
And Connor is looking for his red toy car.
Everything is gone!
Someone is stealing things, whispers Amaya.
Tonight we'll investigate, says Connor.
That night, when the moon is in the sky, they put on their pyjamas.
PJ Masks, let's go!
shouts Catboy.
They run to their headquarters.
That's a big tower in the park, with a cat car, an owl plane and a lizard car.
Catboy jumps into the cat car.
Vroom!
They drive through the quiet city.
All the lights are off.
Everyone is asleep.
Catboy pricks up his ears.
He hears something.
A soft giggle.
Hee hee hee.
It's coming from the school!
They creep up to the school.
Owlette flies above the roof.
With her owl eyes she looks around.
I can see someone!
she whispers.
By the sandpit!
There stands a girl in a purple cape.
It's Luna Girl!
She has a big bag with her.
In the bag are the keys, the hammer, and the red toy car.
Luna Girl!
shouts Catboy.
Why are you taking all those things?
Luna Girl gets a fright.
She wants to fly away on her moon board.
But Gekko quickly climbs up the wall and holds the board.
Catboy jumps in front of her.
He is super fast.
Luna Girl can't get away.
She looks at the ground.
I only wanted to play, she says softly.
During the day I'm always alone.
Nobody plays with me.
So I took things, so I would have something to play with too.
Catboy looks at Owlette and Gekko.
They nod.
Luna Girl, says Catboy, stealing isn't allowed.
The teacher needs her keys.
The caretaker needs his hammer.
But if you want someone to play with, you can just ask.
Luna Girl looks up.
Really?
Will you play with me?
Of course, says Owlette.
But first we'll take everything back.
Together they put the keys back on the teacher's desk.
The hammer in the caretaker's cupboard.
And the red car in Connor's tray.
And then, in the moonlight, they play together.
Catboy and Luna Girl have a running race.
Owlette and Luna Girl race each other in the air.
Gekko builds a big sandcastle.
Luna Girl laughs.
She has never had so much fun.
When the sun comes up, Luna Girl has to go.
Thank you, PJ Masks, she says.
Can I come and play again?
Always, says Catboy.
But without taking anything.
Luna Girl nods and flies away on her moon board.
The next morning at school the teacher finds her keys.
The caretaker finds his hammer.
And Connor finds his red car.
Strange, says the teacher.
I looked everywhere for them.
Connor, Amaya and Greg look at each other and smile.
They don't say anything.
Because it's their secret.
PJ Masks, hooray!
The end.
